title: BICOS
description: An Open Banking application developed during a hackathon hosted by TecBan (company responsible for Banco24Horas ATMs). The project won the competition by showing that users don't need to understand Open Banking to benefit from it.

title: CAM Covers
description: An application that transforms ordinary photos into professional-looking album covers, inspired by real music players.

title: React Native - Zendesk SDK
description: A wrapper for Zendesk SDK in React Native, making it easy to integrate customer support functionality into your mobile apps.

title: Stone World
description: A push box puzzle in pixel art: push rune stones onto an ancient altar, take keys from chests and open gates across 20 hand-made chambers.

title: The Slime Dungeon
description: Survive in a dungeon of slimes! You are stuck with adorable creatures. How long can you survive? Built with Flutter and Bonfire engine.

title: FlyControl
description: Unofficial Fly.io client to check apps and machines, read live logs, follow CPU and memory, and restart a machine from your phone.

title: Tomely
description: Medication reminder that rings on time, even offline, keeps a dose history and warns you before a medication runs out.

title: Direção Fácil
description: Gamified app to help Brazilians pass the CNH theory exam with short lessons and DETRAN-style quizzes.

title: Mini Cenários
description: A cozy decorating game inspired by sticker scene books: unpack each room's moving box and arrange tiny isometric rooms, piece by piece.

title: Ciclogravura
description: A game based on the Brazilian sand bottle craft: pour colored sand, tilt the phone and shape landscapes against the glass, grain by grain.

title: Poker Trainer
description: No Limit Hold'em lessons for beginners: 58 lessons in 13 phases, over 400 exercises and an explanation after every answer. No real money.

title: Love Wrapped
description: Turns a WhatsApp chat between two people into a Wrapped of the relationship, one scene per screen, and a vertical video, all on the phone.
